title: Concept: Mercurial .hg/hgrc file served
description: The hgrc names the internal repository and records whether the web interface permits push. Together with a reachable .hg directory it usually means the filelog is downloadable, which reconstructs the source history.
applicability: Responses from a deployment that copied the repository metadata into the web root.
risk: The caller learns the repository host and, if the directory is browsable, reconstructs the source and its history.
